mapper.select: select em.name ,fou.unit_name,fop.position_name from hls_credit_line_chance_approver ca join sys_user_allocation sua on sua.allocation_id= ca.allocation_id join FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea on fea.employee_assign_id=sua.employee_assign_id join fnd_employee em on em.employee_id=fea.employee_id join fnd_org_unit fou on fou.unit_id=fea.unit_id join fnd_org_position fop on fop.position_id=fea.position_id
